g.text: Data model: the pgvector tables and the index files they load

text.tspan: Dashed arrows: what index load upserts. Both tables share index_version without a foreign key; index load
writes them in one transaction. index_version = <embedder slug>-<first 12 hex of sha256(chunks.jsonl +
embeddings.npy)>, so loading the same index again changes nothing. chunk_id = first 16 hex of sha256(doc_id,
section, ordinal, embedder_id); embedding row i belongs to chunk line i. Exact cosine search (<=>), no ANN
index; the index chunks_version_doc on (index_version, doc_id) serves the case filter.

g.text: data/serving/index · the files of one index version
Postgres 17 + pgvector · created by index load
